name: ESP32-P4 MIPI-CSI camera (OV5647 / SC2336 module)
description: A camera module on the board's MIPI-CSI ribbon connector (Waveshare OV5647 or SC2336 modules, 2-lane). The sensor is detected at boot; its control bus is the board's I2C on GPIO7/8, shared with any I2C display or sensor. Photos are scaled to at most 640 wide and stored as JPEG, the newest 20 kept in flash.
